lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately four identifiable horizontal rows and seven visible vertical columns across the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance circular blobs at regular intervals, forming a discernible rectilinear grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible; the most prominent carina exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge, running parallel to the lateral line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters situated within the macro-mask of the dorsal fin, primarily clustered in the anterior and basal regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct circular/spiral-shaped textural indentation or shadow pattern is visible on the central lateral surface of the first dorsal fin.
